packageRules.description: Go module updates arrive as one pull request. Core carries no non-stdlib require at all (ADR-0002), so this is only ever driver dependencies and tooling, and reviewing them together is cheaper than reviewing them one at a time.
Workflow action updates arrive as one pull request, for the same reason: CI is one artefact and its actions are reviewed as one.

Never touch the Go language or toolchain version. ADR-0002 makes core's `go` directive a deliberate release decision - raising core's floor is never a patch release, because that line decides who can import ferry at all - and CI separately asserts that no driver module sits below core. There is no toolchain directive anywhere in the repo now, and the `go` directive is temporarily 1.26 under #366 for as long as Go 1.27 is not GA, which makes it even more emphatically a human decision. A routine bot bump of any of those three would break a policy nobody would see being broken, so this is a decision that stays with a human.
